positionMethod.name: Position Method
positionMethod.description: The positioning method used to position the tooltip.

side.name: Side
side.description: Which side of the anchor the tooltip should be positioned on.

align.name: Align
align.description: How to align the tooltip relative to the anchor along the side axis.

sideOffset.name: Side Offset
sideOffset.description: Distance in pixels between the tooltip and the anchor element.

alignOffset.name: Align Offset
alignOffset.description: Offset along the alignment axis in pixels.

collisionPadding.name: Collision Padding
collisionPadding.description: Padding between the tooltip and the collision boundary.

arrowPadding.name: Arrow Padding
arrowPadding.description: Minimum distance between the arrow and the tooltip corners.

sticky.name: Sticky
sticky.description: Whether the tooltip should stick in view while scrolling.

disableAnchorTracking.name: Disable Anchor Tracking
disableAnchorTracking.description: Whether to disable tracking of the anchor element position.
